## What happened?

Tell us what went wrong.

Good examples:

- `Read Selected Text` said no selected text in Safari after I selected one paragraph.
- `Pick and Read` finished, but the reader text was blank.
- `Paste Last Text` copied text but did not paste into Notes.
- `Window Left Half` did nothing after I allowed Accessibility.
- `Ask Anything` showed an API key or model error.

## What did you expect?

Tell us what should have happened.

Example: The selected paragraph should appear in the reader and be spoken.

## Steps

1.
2.
3.

Example:

1. Open Safari.
2. Select one paragraph.
3. Open Commands.
4. Run `Read Selected Text`.

## Problem type

Pick one: selected text, screen pick/OCR, paste, window, LLM, app launch, other.

## Support info

Before filing, check [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](../../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

In Fluid Reader, open `Commands` and run `Copy Issue Bundle`.
You can paste that bundle into this issue. It includes support info and the newest safe app events.

If you only need support info, run `Copy Support Info` and paste it here.

If you only need recent safe app events, run `Copy Activity Log` and paste it under extra notes.

Do not paste API keys, selected text, answers, screenshots, private documents, custom prompts, custom endpoints, or clipboard contents.

```text
Paste support info here.
```

## Extra notes

Add anything else that helps. Safe notes include macOS version, app version, permission status, command name, and whether this started after an update.
